contribution_route: evaluation material and reproducible application-consumption evaluation process, NOT registered network scorer
local_protocol: A strict canonical-Intent-shaped offline application sample. For source reviews, params.target is exactly 'Review upstream security regression <case_id> at Git revision <40-lowercase-hex>.' Each accepted result must contain exactly one source-backed typed claim with all original source/test/receipt hashes. For the genuine external paid captures, params.target and original response shapes are used unchanged.
accepted_local_response_shape: body.result.review_claim is exact approved source-review-witness claim; no freeform model scores
local_source_task_contract: Only original GitHub Actions authenticated before/after source facts admitted; exact request case and revision bind to claim. A claimed PASS/FAIL that is contradicted by the authentic record must never authorize consumption.
naive_http_success_baseline: accept any local/real response with status=200 and paid=true, with synthetic paid flags for constructed local controls. The original real public third-party paid captures are reported flags only, NOT cryptographically verified.
reject_everything_baseline: deny all 26; no utility for the eight authenticated narrow, source-supported claims
success_gate: A single fail-closed, strictly parsed local application-consumption contract accepts eight valid source-bound facts, rejects eight contradictory facts and eight altered proofs and rejects the two authentic published off-target paid-flagged outputs; originals Git-verified, primary metric is application allow/deny, with three explicit baselines and no inflated model accuracy claims.
